purpose: Machine-readable gates for the OrgX operator chronicle plugin UX.

acceptableRoutes.description: Client exposes get_operator_chronicle and calls it in-session.
requiredEvidence: active callable tool list includes get_operator_chronicle
tool result includes every requiredReadoutFields entry

acceptableRoutes.description: Client has stale schema or wrapper-only tools and calls orgx_recommend mode=morning_brief.
Client lifecycle hook reconciles missed local evidence after the fact.
requiredEvidence: a later MCP readout is still available for live reporting

clientHookSurfaces.bestAvailableSurface: MCP tool list plus Codex lifecycle hooks
clientHookSurfaces.directReadoutPath: get_operator_chronicle when the active callable namespace exposes it
clientHookSurfaces.fallbackPath: _orgx_recommend or orgx_recommend with mode="morning_brief" when the session only exposes stale wrapper tools
clientHookSurfaces.passiveHookSupport: SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PermissionRequest, and Stop hooks via hooks/codex/hooks.json
clientHookSurfaces.currentGap: Direct get_operator_chronicle exposure is still open in this active Codex session, so passive Stop hooks and the morning-brief fallback are not enough to claim seamless live reporting.

clientHookSurfaces.bestAvailableSurface: Hosted MCP / Apps SDK tool discovery, action controls, and widgets
clientHookSurfaces.directReadoutPath: ChatGPT app action for get_operator_chronicle after tool scan or refresh
clientHookSurfaces.fallbackPath: ChatGPT app action for orgx_recommend with mode="morning_brief" if the scan is stale but the compatibility tool is visible
clientHookSurfaces.currentGap: Action-list UI proof is blocked; Chrome is logged out, native ChatGPT inspection is unavailable here, and Arc automation is unsafe until the unrelated modal is cleared.

clientHookSurfaces.bestAvailableSurface: Claude MCP tools plus lifecycle hooks through the separate orgx-claude-code-plugin
clientHookSurfaces.fallbackPath: orgx_recommend with mode="morning_brief" when direct tool refresh is stale
clientHookSurfaces.passiveHookSupport: SessionStart, PostToolUse, SubagentStop, and Stop through the Claude plugin, not this Codex package
clientHookSurfaces.currentGap: Direct readout is historically proven, but Stop/SessionEnd hook reliability still needs monitoring because a later smoke hung and was killed.

clientHookSurfaces.bestAvailableSurface: Cursor MCP tool surface plus repo-local rules and commands
clientHookSurfaces.directReadoutPath: cursor-agent mcp list-tools orgx exposes get_operator_chronicle, then the OrgX: Morning Brief command calls it first
clientHookSurfaces.fallbackPath: orgx_recommend with mode="morning_brief" from the repo-local OrgX: Morning Brief command if direct tool refresh is stale
clientHookSurfaces.currentGap: Cursor config shape and MCP list discovery are now verified after updating Cursor Agent; remaining proof is OrgX MCP OAuth consent and repeated list-tools durability.

clientHookSurfaces.bestAvailableSurface: OpenCode native plugin plus opencode.json MCP/plugin configuration
clientHookSurfaces.directReadoutPath: OpenCode native plugin calls get_operator_chronicle or orgx_recommend mode="morning_brief" from its configured OrgX MCP/tool bridge
clientHookSurfaces.fallbackPath: Passive Work Graph reconciliation reads summary-only OpenCode events and transcripts as source_client="opencode"
clientHookSurfaces.passiveHookSupport: summary-only Work Graph reconciliation for ~/.opencode and orgx_opencode_plugin_runtime_hook events
clientHookSurfaces.currentGap: OpenCode appears in Work Graph source evidence and the user OpenCode config now exposes an OrgX remote MCP entry. A local OpenCode CLI is now installed on PATH and reads the OrgX MCP config; remaining proof is OrgX MCP OAuth consent and a direct chronicle or morning-brief readout.
